checked_sources: Independent finite check: recursively pair the least remaining endpoint with every other available endpoint; accumulate X, T, X², T² and XT and reduce the resulting integer moment fractions
correctness.rationale: In the uniform matching, edge probabilities and conditioning on a specified chord give the stated exact moments; an independent bit-mask enumeration of all 3, 15, 105, 945, 10395 and 135135 matchings at n=2 through 7 matched all five moments as reduced rational numbers (at n=7 they are 7, 252/13, 28/3, 50568/1859 and 2058/143 in the order EX, ET, Var X, Var T, Cov). For the unbounded argument, ranking iid paired endpoints is uniform and preserves the endpoint order within each pair. The cusp error is O_p(n^(4/3)) by DKW and the bounded chord-length density. In the linear rank correction, conditioning on the first chord gives zero by uniformity; in the reverse direction the one-endpoint contribution J has J(0)=0 and J'(x)=2[f(1-x)-f(x)]=0 a.e., and the centering term vanishes by antisymmetry. Disjoint summands and summands sharing only one index therefore give zero covariance in the off-diagonal sum, so its variance is O(n^2). The projection vector for t uniform on [0,1/2] is (2t(1-t)-1/3, 2t-1/2). Its covariance gives the claimed Gaussian law, determinant 1/8640, limiting slope 1/2 and squared correlation 15/16. Finite enumeration is a check of moments only, not of convergence.
